name: ModelSampling prediction-type overrides
plain: These nodes swap the model's sampling object, telling the sampler how to read model output. Shift values are covered by the scheduler pages; this entry records the prediction maths. Using the wrong type gives broken results, since x0 is computed differently in each one.
math:
x = model input, F = output, σd = sigma_data, x0 = denoised:
eps: x0 = x − F·σ; c_in = 1/√(σ²+σd²); noise: x + n·σ (max_denoise n·√(1+σ²))
v_prediction: x0 = x·σd²/(σ²+σd²) − F·σ·σd/√(σ²+σd²)
edm: as v but plus the F term
x0: x0 = F
img_to_img: x0=F, input not scaled
const/flow: x0 = x − F·σ; no c_in; noise: σ·(s·n) + (1−σ)·x_lat; inverse x/(1−σ)
img_to_img_flow: x0=F; noise_scaling returns latent; inverse 1−latent
img_to_img_velocity: x0 = x − F
cosmos_rflow: s=σ/(σ+1); c_in=(1−s); x0 = x(1−s) − F·s
v_prediction_ddpm (CogVideoX): x0 = x/√(σ²+1) − F·σ/√(σ²+1), unscaled input
lcm: x0_eps = x − Fσ; t=10·timestep; x0 = c_out·x0_eps + c_skip·x, c_skip=.25/(t²+.25), c_out=t/√(t²+.25); base resamples sigmas to 50 steps.

props.architectures: Set by the node, not checked. ModelSamplingDiscrete / ContinuousEDM / ContinuousV / SD3 / AuraFlow / Flux / StableCascade build a new class from base+type each call.

label: from code
surprise: ModelSamplingDiscrete 'lcm' also swaps the base class to a 50-sigma distilled grid, so it is more than a prediction type.
